summary: Pluri Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its indirect majority-owned subsidiary, Ever After Foods Ltd. (EAF), entered into a share purchase agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Fishway BV from its shareholders. Consideration is EAF ordinary shares; Pluri's indirect ownership in EAF will drop from ~69% to ~58% due to issuance. Separately, EAF signed a SAFE agreement for $2.0 million investment. Closing expected within 30 days, subject to approvals. No price per share or premium disclosed; watch regulatory approvals and dilution impact.
